task_title: Speed up theme-equipment judging (cap 16->6 + bounded rejudge concurrency)

plan_review.notes: Separate-model (rubber-duck/gpt-5.6-sol) plan review. 3 blocking concerns, all folded into the design pre-implementation: (1) strict concurrency validation (finite int >=1, reject NaN/Inf/fraction/neg) + clamp workers to min(concurrency,eligible) + judgeMaxVariants constrained 1..64; (2) on worker error, drain all in-flight workers before throwing (worker pool that self-catches; Promise.all settles then rethrow first error) - no orphaned Azure writes after rejection; (3) extend guard to reject concurrency>1 with judgeBudget OR judgeCache (cache check-then-call race). Non-blocking folded in: build returned Maps in considered-variant order (deterministic iteration); candidate-keyed test provider (detect cross-variant mis-association); rerun/theme wiring test (6 calls, peak concurrency 4); share the exported cap constant (no literal 6); document 62.5%-unjudged tradeoff in handoff; narrow claim to up to 8x rejudge / ~4x overall. Design shape unchanged -> convergent.
